label: Question 1
what: Borrows $275M for public college buildings: $165M for a new Integrated Health Building at URI's Kingston campus, $60M for a CCRI Workforce Innovation Center in Warwick, and $50M for a student success and career readiness center in RIC's Adams Library.
y: The state may issue up to $275 million in general obligation bonds for these projects.
fiscal: At the Senate Fiscal Office's assumptions (5% interest, 20-year bonds, full issuance in year 1): about $22.0M a year in debt service, $441.3M total including $166.3M interest. The SFO estimates $48.1M a year and $962.9M total for all five 2026 bonds ($600M).
pro: University of Rhode Island, Rhode Island College, Community College of Rhode Island, Gov. McKee and General Assembly (FY2027 budget)

reasons.services: Funds new health-education and workforce-training buildings at URI, CCRI and RIC.
reasons.fiscal: Adds $275M of state debt, about $22M a year to repay over 20 years.

label: Question 2
what: Borrows $120M to increase and preserve affordable and accessible housing and to support community revitalization. At least $25M must go to homeownership housing and up to $10M may support a public housing development program.
y: The state may issue up to $120 million in general obligation bonds for these projects.
fiscal: Senate Fiscal Office estimate: about $9.6M a year in debt service, $192.6M total including $72.6M interest. The SFO estimates $48.1M a year and $962.9M total for all five 2026 bonds ($600M).
pro: Gov. McKee and General Assembly (FY2027 budget), RI Executive Office of Housing

reasons.housing: Funds production and preservation of affordable housing, including at least $25M for homeownership.
reasons.fiscal: Adds $120M of state debt, about $9.6M a year to repay over 20 years.

label: Question 3

label: Question 4
t: State History Center and preservation grants bond
what: Borrows $50M: $45M to build a new Rhode Island State History Center and $5M for matching grants for historic sites and museums, administered by the Historical Preservation and Heritage Commission.
y: The state may issue up to $50 million in general obligation bonds for these projects.
fiscal: At the Senate Fiscal Office's assumptions (5% interest, 20-year bonds, full issuance in year 1): about $4.0M a year in debt service, $80.2M total including $30.2M interest. The SFO estimates $48.1M a year and $962.9M total for all five 2026 bonds ($600M).
pro: Gov. McKee and General Assembly (FY2027 budget)

reasons.fiscal: Adds $50M of state debt, about $4M a year to repay over 20 years.

label: Question 5
t: Green economy and water infrastructure bond
what: Borrows $55M for environmental projects: $25M Resilient Rhody local water-infrastructure fund, $12M for state recreation facilities, $7M for Narragansett Bay and watershed restoration, $3M each for brownfields, farmland preservation and open space, and $1M each for local recreation grants and marine infrastructure.
y: The state may issue up to $55 million in general obligation bonds for these projects.
fiscal: At the Senate Fiscal Office's assumptions (5% interest, 20-year bonds, full issuance in year 1): about $4.4M a year in debt service, $88.3M total including $33.3M interest. The SFO estimates $48.1M a year and $962.9M total for all five 2026 bonds ($600M).
pro: Gov. McKee and General Assembly (FY2027 budget)

reasons.services: Funds local water-infrastructure aid, recreation facilities and watershed cleanup.
reasons.fiscal: Adds $55M of state debt, about $4.4M a year to repay over 20 years.
